mapper.select: SELECT id, account_name, account_number, bank_name, balance, account_type, summary, transaction_time, transaction_type, amount, status, create_time, update_time FROM general_ledger ORDER BY transaction_time DESC
SELECT id, account_name, account_number, bank_name, balance, account_type, summary, transaction_time, transaction_type, amount, status, create_time, update_time FROM general_ledger WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, account_name, account_number, bank_name, balance, account_type, summary, transaction_time, transaction_type, amount, status, create_time, update_time FROM general_ledger WHERE account_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountName}, '%') ORDER BY transaction_time DESC

SELECT id, account_name, account_number, bank_name, balance, account_type, summary, transaction_time, transaction_type, amount, status, create_time, update_time FROM general_ledger WHERE transaction_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY transaction_time DESC

SELECT id, account_name, account_number, bank_name, balance, account_type, summary, transaction_time, transaction_type, amount, status, create_time, update_time FROM general_ledger WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY transaction_time DESC

SELECT id, account_name, account_number, bank_name, balance, account_type, summary, transaction_time, transaction_type, amount, status, create_time, update_time FROM general_ledger ORDER BY transaction_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO general_ledger (account_name, account_number, bank_name, balance, account_type, summary, transaction_time, transaction_type, amount, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{accountName}, #{accountNumber}, #{bankName}, #{balance}, #{accountType}, #{summary}, #{transactionTime}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE general_ledger SET account_name = #{accountName}, account_number = #{accountNumber}, bank_name = #{bankName}, balance = #{balance}, account_type = #{accountType}, summary = #{summary}, transaction_time = #{transactionTime}, transaction_type = #{transactionType}, amount = #{amount}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
